story_sequence.text: Program-level governance still resolves through explicit `git-workflow-*.md` when present.
`beacon qa run <lake>` accepts the aggregation branch after workspace admission and does not block with `branch_alignment_required`.
Repos without program-level contract/topology continue to resolve `beacon/<version>/<feature-slug>`.
Soft admission still blocks wrong current branch with `branch_alignment_required` using the shared resolved target.
When child refs `beacon/<version>/*` exist, resolver selects a non-conflicting aggregation branch (`beacon/<version>/_agg` by default or governance override) instead of bare `beacon/<version>`.
A per-feature deterministic implementation contract with `target_branch` + `worktree_root` but without explicit program-level authority resolves as `per-feature`, not `program-level`.
Program-level aggregation worktree resolves under `.beacon/worktrees/<version>` (or governance worktree path), never the primary repo checkout path.
Admission failure caused by nested parent/child refs emits `aggregation_branch_nested_ref_conflict`.
